toegepas.voor: Daarom kan ons dowwe en baie ver dinge sien.
toegepas.na: Daarom kan ons dinge sien wat dof en baie ver weg is.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'baie ver dinge' is wooden as an attributive phrase; a relative clause reads naturally and keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'dowwe en baie ver dinge' uses 'ver' as a stiff attributive adjective that a careful editor would mark.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The relative clause reads naturally and keeps both qualities, dim and very far, with nothing added.

toegepas.voor: van van die grootste teleskope in die wêreld
toegepas.na: van sommige van die grootste teleskope in die wêreld
toegepas.rede_vinder: The doubled 'van van' is grammatical but reads like a typo to a learner; 'sommige van' keeps the partitive meaning and leaves 'die tuiste van' intact.
toegepas.fout: 'die tuiste van van die grootste' doubles 'van' and reads like a typo on a first reading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'sommige van' keeps the partitive meaning, removes the stumble and leaves the protected 'die tuiste van' intact.

toegepas.voor: hoe dowwer die dinge wat dit kan sien
toegepas.na: hoe dowwer is die dinge wat die teleskoop kan sien
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'dit' points back to the mirror, which does not see; naming the telescope fixes the reference, and 'is' completes the elliptical clause.
toegepas.fout: 'dit' in 'wat dit kan sien' points back to the mirror, and a mirror does not see.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the telescope fixes the reference and 'is' completes the clause without changing the size-light-dimness relation.

toegepas.voor: en dit kan jou oë nie sien nie
toegepas.na: en jou oë kan dit nie sien nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: With the object fronted the subject is unclear at first reading; subject-first word order is clearer for Grade 6.
toegepas.fout: 'dit kan jou oë nie sien nie' can be read at first as 'it cannot see your eyes'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Subject-first order removes the ambiguity with the same meaning, and the AWS comma before 'en' stays.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'baie klein' can be read as 'very small' instead of 'many small'; 'talle' keeps the meaning 'many' without the ambiguity.
toegepas.fout: 'baie klein antennas' can be read as 'very small antennas' instead of 'many small antennas'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'talle' fixes the evident reading, which matches 'baie skottels' in the Karoo sentence, and the change stays in Australia's own sentence without linking it to the dishes or to 'een groot teleskoop'.

toegepas.na: kan self om gevare heen ry
toegepas.rede_vinder: Driving around an obstacle is 'om ... heen ry' in idiomatic Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'om gevare ry' is loose, and 'om' can be misread as purposive.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'om ... heen ry' is the idiomatic form for driving around something and keeps the meaning exactly.

laat_vaar.voor: Rekenaars maak van die radiogolwe inligting en beelde.
laat_vaar.na: Rekenaars verander die radiogolwe in inligting en beelde.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The fronted 'van die radiogolwe' makes the sentence awkward; 'verander ... in' states the same process plainly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'maak van die radiogolwe inligting en beelde' is natural Afrikaans, so the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Die Maanrover: mense ry op die Maan
laat_vaar.na: meer verken as wat hulle te voet kon
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The elliptical comparison 'as te voet' is loose; completing it makes the comparison clear.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The short comparison 'as te voet' is natural Afrikaans, and completing it only makes the sentence longer.

laat_vaar.voor: en daar sit niemand in nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The split 'daar ... in' is spoken style; written standard Afrikaans keeps 'daarin' together.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Splitting 'daar ... in' is ordinary written Afrikaans, not a fault, so the proposal is lateral.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'stuur vir die rover' is colloquial; 'stuur na' is the natural written form for sending over a distance.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'stuur vir die rover opdragte' is standard Afrikaans with the same recipient, so swapping the preposition is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.blok: Wiele en asse laat 'n rover rol
laat_vaar.voor: in plaas daarvan om te sleep
laat_vaar.na: in plaas daarvan dat dit sleep
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'om te sleep' suggests the vehicle drags something; 'dat dit sleep' makes the vehicle itself the one that drags.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: In 'om te sleep' the vehicle is clearly the one dragging, and the proposal has the same supposed ambiguity, so nothing improves.

laat_vaar.voor: om hulle van naby te ondersoek
laat_vaar.na: om dit van naby te ondersoek
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'hulle' could point back to the Marsrovers; 'dit' refers clearly to the rocks and soil.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'hulle' reads naturally as the rocks and soil, while singular 'dit' could point to the arm or the tools, so the change adds an ambiguity.

na_skrywer.blok: Wiele en asse laat 'n rover rol
na_skrywer.voor: Jou klas se model-rover toets hoe goed
na_skrywer.na: Met julle klas se model-rover toets julle hoe goed
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: As written the model rover itself does the testing; the learners test with it, and 'julle' fits a class activity.
na_skrywer.fout: The model rover is the grammatical subject of 'toets', so the model seems to do the testing.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but the proposal switches the lesson's 'jou' to 'julle' and adds an action for the learners, so the writer must choose the fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
